exact_statement: For every finite residual product space with a common real orthonormal basis, two real unit-L2-norm children with coefficients g_T,h_T and an independent Bernoulli selector of bias p in (0,1), set q_T=(1-p)g_T^2+p*h_T^2, u_T=p*h_T^2/q_T, v_T=p*(1-p)*(h_T-g_T)^2/q_T, omitting zero q_T. Then J-M=h2(p)-sum_T q_T*(h2(u_T)+h2(v_T)) and sum_T q_T*u_T=p. For beta=arcsin(sqrt(p)) and (sqrt(1-p)g_T,sqrt(p)h_T)=sqrt(q_T)*(cos(t_T),sin(t_T)), this is h2(p)-sum_T q_T*F_p(t_T), F_p(t)=h2(sin^2(t))+h2(sin^2(t-beta)). Thus J-M<=tau(p)=h2(p)-min_t F_p(t). To use beta=arcsin(sqrt(min(p,1-p))), first swap physical children when p>1/2. The scalar envelope obeys tau(p)=(p/2)*log2(1/p)+(log2(e)/2-1)*p+O(p^2*log(1/p)) as p->0. Writing Delta(p)=h2(p)+log2(1-p) for p<=1/2, the scalar inequality F_p(t)>=h2(p)-Delta(p)/2 holds for every real t when 0<p<=2/25, and for t=beta+e when 489/1000<=p<=1/2 and abs(e)<=301/1000. No complete middle-region half-tax certificate, Boolean attainment, multi-bit additivity or universal influence payment is accepted by this statement.
